_comment: Copy to autopilot.json at the repo root. These are the decisions autopilot would otherwise have to ask you for on every video. Set them once.
_budget: Hard ceilings. The brief is truncated to fit, so a typo in an idea cannot bill a feature film. max_seconds is the wallet's limit; the run also never generates more shots than target_seconds asked for.
_trim: Generated shots settle in the first frames and drift in the last. Trimmed off every clip before rendering.
_publish: Destinations stack. privacy is unlisted by default: the upload happens without asking, but the video is not public until you say so here. dest_dir is only used by the 'local' destination.
